name: whole-token matching
why: A substring scorer matched 'out' inside 'rollout'. Query terms must be whole tokens.

name: stopwords carry no signal
why: A common stopword should not produce a confident ranking.

name: distinctive term outranks common one
why: A distinctive term should rank its record first as the corpus grows.

name: title match beats body match
why: A curated title is stronger evidence of aboutness than an incidental body match.

name: no query terms returns nothing
why: An empty query is not a match-everything query.

name: unmatched term returns nothing
why: Absence of results is a valid answer.

name: quality flags travel with results
why: Retrieval must preserve each result's freshness and evidence state.

name: results are bounded by default
why: An agent-facing retrieval tool should return a bounded ranked set.

name: an oversized limit is capped
why: A caller cannot use an oversized request to retrieve the whole corpus.
